purpose: Resolve prospectively the common-random-number ambiguity identified by the RNG-semantics audit by freezing a condition-independent external-sensory draw schedule. This artifact clarifies the existing preregistered design; it does not execute it or implement the required runtime change.

rng_semantics_audit.resolution_selected: Audit option 3: fixed dense-index draws with explicit eligibility rules, retaining the existing MaleCNSBrain.rng generator.

frozen_pre_extraction_addendum.relevance: Preserves the prospective, outcome-independent boundary and frozen replay-source conventions; it is not altered or superseded by this RNG clarification.

files.role: MaleCNSBrain RNG ownership, external-event draw, refractory logic, and neural transition semantics
frozen sensory encoder and rate computation
selected six-channel runtime composition and RNG-state provenance

frozen_sensory_mapping_and_interface_ide.role: frozen six tibial sensory population membership

authorized_crn_resolution.rng_ownership: RNG ownership remains with the existing MaleCNSBrain.rng NumPy generator. No separate RNG stream, pre-generated random table, stateless generator, or other random provider is permitted.
authorized_crn_resolution.bit_generator: PCG64 as supplied by the tracked NumPy default_rng implementation; the PCG64 implementation is unchanged.
authorized_crn_resolution.population_scope: The validated union of the frozen LF, LM, LH, RF, RM, and RH sensory populations only.
authorized_crn_resolution.slot_order: Map the 392 slots deterministically to the 392 unique sensory members in strictly increasing dense-neuron-index order.
authorized_crn_resolution.neuronwise_pairing: Dense neuron i receives the same RNG slot and underlying random variate in every condition originating from the same seed and branch point at the same neural timestep.
authorized_crn_resolution.unconditional_slot_consumption: Consume all 392 slots at every neural timestep regardless of whether encoded external_drive is zero, the neuron is refractory, or the neuron is otherwise ineligible to receive an external sensory event at that timestep.
authorized_crn_resolution.zero_drive_rule: For a zero-drive neuron, consume and discard its assigned variate; that slot cannot produce an external sensory event.
authorized_crn_resolution.refractory_or_ineligible_rule: For a refractory or otherwise ineligible neuron, consume and discard its assigned variate; that slot cannot produce an external sensory event.
authorized_crn_resolution.eligible_positive_drive_rule: For an eligible positive-drive neuron, compare that neuron's assigned dense-index variate using the existing unchanged event-probability rule.
authorized_crn_resolution.unchanged_event_probability_rule: The existing comparison probability external_drive[dense_index] * (dt / 1000) remains unchanged.
authorized_crn_resolution.unchanged_semantics: The encoder, rate computation, event-probability equation, refractory semantics, neural transition semantics, PCG64 implementation, and all unrelated runtime behavior remain unchanged except for this fixed external-sensory RNG draw schedule.
authorized_crn_resolution.crn_objective: The objective is identical underlying random variates mapped to the same (seed, neural timestep, dense sensory neuron) across conditions, not identical stochastic event outcomes across conditions.
authorized_crn_resolution.permitted_causal_divergence: Event outcomes may diverge causally because condition-specific rates, eligibility, and refractory state may differ.
authorized_crn_resolution.branch_rng_copy_rule: After the 250.0-ms branch point, every branch begins from an exact copy of the same complete MaleCNSBrain.rng bit-generator state.
authorized_crn_resolution.post_step_rng_alignment: Because every branch consumes exactly 392 variates in the same dense-index order at every neural timestep, MaleCNSBrain.rng state and stream position must remain identical across branches after each corresponding timestep, assuming no unauthorized consumer is introduced.

fail_closed_conditions: The frozen sensory population does not resolve to exactly 392 unique dense indices.
Dense-index ordering differs from the ordering derived from the frozen mapping.
Another MaleCNSBrain.rng consumer exists or is introduced that makes cross-condition consumption condition-dependent.
Any branch consumes other than exactly 392 external-sensory variates in any neural timestep.
Corresponding branches do not begin with identical complete RNG state.
The neuron-to-variate mapping cannot be verified.
Any required provenance path, SHA-256 identity, source identity, mapping identity, or bit-generator identity differs.
failure_policy: Abort before interpreting or inspecting recruitment outcomes. Do not retry, substitute a seed, or accept partial branch results.

scientific_interpretation.change_made: This clarification changes the RNG scheduling semantics needed to implement the preregistered common-random-number design. The tracked compact eligible-recipient-only schedule must not be used for this assay.
does_not_change: candidate decoder weights or coordinate signs

future_implementation_requirements_not_e: Implement only the fixed external-sensory RNG draw schedule in a separately reviewed change.
Verify the exact 392-member unique ordered dense-index mapping before any neural step.
Verify branch-point RNG-state equality and corresponding post-step RNG-state equality.
Verify per-timestep draw count and neuron-to-variate slot mapping without using candidate outcomes.
Reject any unauthorized MaleCNSBrain.rng consumer or condition-dependent consumption.
